citation: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ — fa links to a perfect-tense narrative verb (ordinary sequence); no mood is in play. Candidate-only, not certified.

لَا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَقْعُدَ مَذْمُومًا مَّخْذُولًا — fa follows a prohibition and the linked verb تَقْعُدَ carries the visible subjunctive fatḥa; fā' al-sababiyya, licensed by an implied أَنْ, not by fa itself. Candidate-only, not certified.

REFUSAL CONTROL, not a claim about this word's true reading: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ is the same sababiyya frame as fa-occ-002 (17:22:7), but ayah 80:4 is currently absent from the repository's own address spine (a coverage accident, matching the established N1/N2/N4 refusal-control pattern in tools/test_nahw_governor_families.py). Evidence is never minted for an out-of-scope address; the correct behaviour is refusal, not fabrication.
فَإِنْ أَمِنَ بَعْضُكُم بَعْضًا فَلْيُؤَدِّ ٱلَّذِى ٱؤْتُمِنَ أَمَانَتَهُۥ — fa links the apodosis; the jussive on يُؤَدِّ is governed by لْ (lām al-amr), never by fa. Candidate-only, not certified.

وَقَالَتْ أُولَىٰهُمْ لِأُخْرَىٰهُمْ فَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِن فَضْلٍ — fa resumes/links; the following مَا is a DISTINCT negation particle whose own function (negation, before the perfect verb كَانَ) is decided independently by negation_effect()/maa_context_frame() at this same address, never fused into a blended 'fa_plus_negation' label. Candidate-only, not certified.
